title: Chain
description: Schema for a single CTF attack-chain playbook. YAML files under chains/ are loaded, validated against this schema, then bundled into js/chains.js.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the filename (without extension).

description.description: Short explanation of what this chain accomplishes.

inputs.description: Variables the chain consumes from profile/context before running.

name.description: snake_case variable name used in ${...} substitution.

source.description: Optional auto-fill source. Currently supported: target_context.<field> (ip, user, domain, password, hash, ...).

next_chains.description: Natural follow-up chains. Renders as 'continue with' hops at the end of this chain. Forms the navigable attack tree across the chain library.

chain.description: id of the follow-up chain (validated against CHAIN_DATA).

when.description: Optional one-line precondition shown in the UI (e.g. 'once you have a Pwn3d! host').

id.description: Step identifier, unique within the chain.

command_ref.description: Id of an existing command (validated against COMMAND_DATA at validate time).

inline_command.description: Escape hatch: write the command template here instead of referencing an existing one.

branch.description: One-of selection. The runner shows a chooser; user picks which variant to execute. Exactly one of command_ref/inline_command/branch must be set per step.

when.description: Variable name whose presence enables this branch (e.g. 'password', 'hash', 'ticket').

requires.description: Variables that must be populated before this step is unblocked.

inputs.description: Map of command placeholder (e.g. 'dc-ip', 'hash_file') to value template. Use ${var} to interpolate chain variables.

capture.description: Regex extractors run against pasted output to populate downstream variables.

regex.description: JavaScript-compatible regex source. Multiline by default.

match.description: first: single value (or first capture group); all: array of all matches.

transform.description: Post-processing applied to the matched string(s).

groups.description: When set, the result is an object built from named groups. Keys = result field names, values = regex group indices (1-based).
